Refined spend scores preserve the base additive model for global structure and constrain only the account-I/O terms from the orthogonal sweeps.
Spend profiles and sweeps are now derived from an explicit spend-statement arithmetization rather than hand-entered verifier proxy counts.
The q parameter is a literal absolute verifier-query count in the current model, not query rounds or an internally batched effective count.
Circle and WHIR spend profiles now attach protocol-backed lower/upper query-soundness estimates rather than leaving q as an unlabeled screening knob.
The recovered inversion coefficient is folded into spend scoring only if the Winterfell-aligned inversion sweep succeeds without failures.

Spend field_inv_ops now uses structural divisor and batch-inversion counts rather than the earlier query-scaled proxy; boundary groups are derived from an explicit AIR layout and low-degree batches are tied to named protocol stages.
A second spend sweep now varies rate, grinding, security target (100/120/128 bits), and inferred optimization scenarios jointly before scoring cost.
